text:
zoe: Quick preflight for the release + webinar next Tue. Marketing needs the changelog PR merged and two doc anchors so CTAs don't 404. Can eng/docs land by EOD tomorrow?
carlos: Share the PR link and exact anchors. I can block a 45m canary on day-of.
zoe: Changelog PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4892  changelog file at docs/changes/2026-09-14-release.md. Anchors requested: 'traffic-safeguards' and 'dedicated-onramp'. Also want a one-line fallback copy for the blog.
mei: I'll add anchors and a tiny dedicated section. Proposed anchor text: "Traffic safeguards & failover" -> #traffic-safeguards, and "Dedicated onramp" -> #dedicated-onramp. Will include a sample CTA payload. Docs PR in ~2h.
carlos: Fallback copy OK: "Under peak load, requests may route to a compatible smaller model to preserve latency." Ops: @deploy-bot please reserve canary slot and tag the RC.
deploy-bot: Canary reserved: 2026-09-14T09:00:00-07:00 to 2026-09-14T09:45:00-07:00. RC tag: rc/2026-09-14-pulse.
ivy: Growth needs the final docs URL for the signup form. Can you include a short webhook example in the docs so we can test?
mei: Added sample webhook snippet in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288 
```
{"event":"lead_signup","source":"blog_cta","interest":"dedicated"}
```
zoe: Timeline: docs + changelog merged by Mon 20:00 UTC, canary Tue 09:00-09:45 PT, public post Tue 10:15 PT, webinar Wed 17:00 UTC. Partner pre-announce 20m before public post. If canary shows >15% latency regression we revert and publish a webinar-only note.
carlos: Eng good. I'll merge changelog after docs are live and run a quick anchor resolution test. If anchors 404 hold publish for up to 2h.
zoe: Thanks team  I'll draft the blog with exact anchor links and queue partner pre-announce. Ping here for any timing shifts."
